plans.title: Attack Delta Amex + Rebuild Checking
plans.description: $1,350 from every non-rent paycheck and $525 from every rent paycheck goes to Delta Amex ($4,988.84 @ 28.24% APR). Route groceries, gas, dining out, and slop (~$410/paycheck) to Blue Cash Preferred for cashback. Caps: groceries $225, gas $60, parking $10, subscriptions $40 (kill duplicates), partying $40, dining out $75, slop $50, misc/other $150.
